ACTUAL NATIVE EXECUTION

C++20 benchmark

Two real threads, 1,024 usable slots, one million messages per round. Median of five rounds against a bounded mutex queue. Environment-specific measurements, not a universal speedup.

Loading recorded results…

01 / OWNERSHIP

One writer. One reader.

The native queue supports exactly one producer and one consumer. It is not a multi-producer queue.

02 / VISIBILITY

Publish, then observe.

The producer writes a slot before publishing the head with release ordering. The consumer observes that head with acquire ordering.

03 / LAYOUT

Space between counters.

The native head and tail are aligned to 64 bytes. This is a layout choice, not proof of a particular performance gain.
